# Test fixtures directory
#
# This directory contains PCAP files and other test data used by the test suite.
#
# Files:
#   sample.pcap    — A small, sanitized PCAP with common protocol examples
#   malformed.pcap — A PCAP with intentionally malformed/truncated packets
#
# IMPORTANT: Never commit PCAP files containing real network traffic.
# All PCAP fixtures must be synthetically generated or fully sanitized.
# Verify that no personal data, credentials, or sensitive information
# is present before committing any PCAP file.
